title: Has LLM Screening Performance Stalled in Software Engineering Systematic Reviews?
title_zh: 大型语言模型在软件工程系统综述中的筛选性能是否已陷入停滞？

paragraphs.en: Screening in systematic reviews (SRs) is manual and time-consuming. Prior work has explored large language models (LLMs) for automating this step, but LLMs are evolving rapidly, so earlier performance claims may no longer accurately reflect their screening performance. We used an existing software engineering SR screening benchmark (SESR-Eval) as our data. We also power-sampled a new, smaller dataset (SESR-Eval-Mini) that allows evaluation at lower costs. Using this data, we evaluated eight new LLMs for screening performance. Additionally, we tested different prompts, analyzed LLM agreement in screening decisions and criteria, and examined the effect of refining the inclusion and exclusion criteria on screening performance. The eight new LLMs performed marginally better than the seven old ones: avg. MCC across secondary studies rose from 0.347 to 0.365. Differences between secondary studies are still bigger than between LLMs. Computing the overall screening decision from criterion-level decisions degraded screening performance only slightly. LLMs generally agree with each other in their corresponding screening decisions (mean Gwet’s AC1 = 0.830), though certain inclusion and exclusion criteria showed larger disagreement than others. Refining the inclusion and exclusion criteria slightly improved recall and made decisions easier for some LLMs, but overall impacts of criteria refinement were modest. LLMs are not yet ready to replace humans in paper screening and the advantages new, more costly models bring, appear to be very limited. Agent-based approaches, prompt engineering, and further criteria refinement are three potential future research avenues.
paragraphs.zh: 系统综述（SR）中的文献筛选过程是手动操作且耗时较长的。先前的研究曾探索使用大型语言模型（LLM）来自动化这一环节，但大型语言模型正在快速发展，因此早期的性能评估结果可能已无法准确反映其当前的筛选能力。我们采用了一个现有的软件工程领域系统综述筛选基准数据集（SESR-Eval）作为研究数据。此外，我们还通过增强采样法构建了一个规模更小、成本更低的新数据集（SESR-Eval-Mini），以便进行更经济高效的评估。基于这些数据，我们对八款新型大型语言模型的筛选性能进行了评估。同时，我们还测试了不同的提示策略，分析了大型语言模型在筛选决策和标准上的一致性，并考察了优化纳入与排除标准对筛选性能的影响。这八款新型大型语言模型的表现略优于七款旧模型：在二级研究中，平均MCC值从0.347提升至0.365。不同二级研究之间的差异仍然大于不同大型语言模型之间的差异。基于标准层级的决策计算整体筛选结果时，仅对筛选性能造成了轻微影响。大型语言模型在对应的筛选决策上通常表现出较高的一致性（Gwet’s AC1均值为0.830），但某些纳入与排除标准与其他标准相比存在更大的分歧。优化纳入与排除标准略微提升了召回率，并使部分大型语言模型的决策过程更为简单，但标准优化的整体影响有限。目前，大型语言模型尚不足以替代人类进行文献筛选，而新型、成本更高的模型所带来的优势似乎也非常有限。基于智能体的方法、提示工程以及进一步的纳入与排除标准优化，是未来研究的三个潜在方向。

paragraphs.en: Evidence-Based Software Engineering (EBSE) highlights systematic reviews (SRs) as a key method for gathering and synthesizing evidence in software engineering (SE) ( Kitchenham et al., 2004 ) . However, conducting SRs is labor-intensive and time-consuming ( Felizardo et al., 2025 ) . According to Marshall and Wallace (2019) , a single SR can take an average of 67 weeks to complete, with paper screening representing one of the most demanding phases. Prior work has shown that humans spend approximately 89 seconds screening each individual paper ( Huotala et al., 2024 ) , which makes paper screening a substantial bottleneck in the SR process as thousands of papers may require screening.
paragraphs.zh: 基于证据的软件工程（EBSE）强调系统综述（SR）是收集与整合软件工程（SE）领域证据的关键方法（Kitchenham 等，2004）。 然而，开展系统综述需要大量人力且耗时较长（Felizardo 等，2025）。 根据 Marshall 和 Wallace（2019）的研究，完成一篇系统综述平均需要 67 周时间，其中论文筛选是最耗时的阶段之一。 先前的研究指出，人类平均每篇论文的筛选时间约为 89 秒（Huotala 等，2024），这使得论文筛选成为系统综述流程中的重大瓶颈，因为可能需要筛选数千篇论文。

paragraphs.en: Automating or supporting paper screening has therefore attracted considerable attention. Earlier approaches have used traditional Machine Learning (ML) and Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques ( Hamel et al., 2020 ) , while recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used because of their ability to reason over textual input ( Huotala et al., 2024 ; Huotala et al., 2025a ; Felizardo et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Delgado-Chaves et al., 2025 ; Shameem et al., 2026 ; Thode et al., 2025 ; Tran et al., 2023 ; Matsui et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2024 ; Serretti, 2026 ; Trad et al., 2025 ; Adam et al., 2026 ) . Existing studies show promise for paper screening using LLMs, as LLMs achieve performance comparable to that of non-expert human screeners ( Huotala et al., 2024 ; Huotala et al., 2025a ; Felizardo et al., 2024 ) . Yet, against expert human screeners, LLMs still make a considerable number of mistakes stemming from sources such as different interpretations of key terms ( Mäntylä et al., 2026 ) . Guidelines for LLM usage have been proposed to mitigate their errors ( Madeyski et al., 2026 ) . Human-in-the-loop systems have also been developed to support researchers in applying LLMs and other automation methods to paper screening ( Huotala et al., 2026a ; Deizepe et al., 2026 ; Afonso et al., 2026 ; Ouzzani et al., 2016 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 因此，对论文筛选进行自动化或提供支持已引起了广泛关注。 早期的方法使用了传统的机器学习（ML）和自然语言处理（NLP）技术（Hamel 等，2020），而近期则开始使用大型语言模型（LLM），因为它们能够对文本输入进行推理（Huotala 等，2024；Huotala 等，2025a；Felizardo 等，2024；Li 等，2024；Delgado-Chaves 等，2025；Shameem 等，2026；Thode 等，2025；Tran 等，2023；Matsui 等，2024；Guo 等，2024；Serretti，2026；Trad 等，2025；Adam 等，2026）。 现有研究表明，使用 LLM 进行论文筛选具有前景，因为 LLM 的表现可与非专家人类筛选者相媲美（Huotala 等，2024；Huotala 等，2025a；Felizardo 等，2024）。 然而，与专家级的人类筛选者相比，LLM 仍然会犯下大量错误，这些错误源于对关键术语的不同解释等问题（Mäntylä 等，2026）。 为了减少 LLM 的错误，相关的使用指南已被提出（Madeyski 等，2026）。 此外，还开发出了“人在回路”系统，以支持研究人员将 LLM 和其他自动化方法应用于论文筛选（Huotala 等，2026a；Deizepe 等，2026；Afonso 等，2026；Ouzzani 等，2016）。

paragraphs.en: This paper extends our prior work ( Huotala et al., 2025a ) , which introduced the SESR-Eval dataset for monitoring artificial intelligence (AI) performance in paper screening. Nine LLMs were benchmarked, and most of them performed similarly. However, the differences in screening accuracy between the secondary studies were greater than differences between LLMs, but LLMs were fairly cheap to use per secondary study. While the benchmark dataset can be used to benchmark LLMs, LLMs were still not recommended for automating paper screening process.
paragraphs.zh: 本文拓展了我们之前的工作（Huotala 等人，2025a），该工作首次提出了用于监测人工智能（AI）在论文筛选中性能的 SESR-Eval 数据集。 我们对九种大型语言模型进行了基准测试，其中大多数模型的表现相似。 然而，二次研究之间的筛选准确率差异大于大型语言模型之间的差异，但每次二次研究中使用大型语言模型的成本相当低。 尽管该基准数据集可用于对大型语言模型进行基准测试，但我们仍然不建议使用大型语言模型来自动化论文筛选流程。

sents.en: This paper extends our prior work ( Huotala et al., 2025a ) , which introduced the SESR-Eval dataset for monitoring artificial intelligence (AI) performance in paper screening.
sents.zh: 本文拓展了我们之前的工作（Huotala 等人，2025a），该工作首次提出了用于监测人工智能（AI）在论文筛选中性能的 SESR-Eval 数据集。

sents.en: Nine LLMs were benchmarked, and most of them performed similarly.
sents.zh: 我们对九种大型语言模型进行了基准测试，其中大多数模型的表现相似。

sents.en: However, the differences in screening accuracy between the secondary studies were greater than differences between LLMs, but LLMs were fairly cheap to use per secondary study.
sents.zh: 然而，二次研究之间的筛选准确率差异大于大型语言模型之间的差异，但每次二次研究中使用大型语言模型的成本相当低。

sents.zh: 尽管该基准数据集可用于对大型语言模型进行基准测试，但我们仍然不建议使用大型语言模型来自动化论文筛选流程。

paragraphs.en: Next we explain the difference between this paper and Huotala et al. (2025a) . First, the evaluated LLMs covered only a single generation of models, prompt, and an output schema, which leaves it unclear whether newer LLMs, different user prompts or output schemas would further improve screening performance and make paper screening feasible with LLMs. Claims of earlier generation models may no longer accurately reflect the capabilities of newer models in paper screening, and benchmarking additional LLMs for paper screening benefit researchers and practitioners in choosing a cost-efficient LLM with an acceptable performance for the task (RQ1 – RQ2). Benchmarking LLMs on a full dataset (N = 34,528) may not be financially sensible, as LLMs are generally expensive to run ( Felizardo et al., 2025 ) , and token costs of LLMs have increased due to test-time inference and additional model capabilities, such as thinking models (RQ1.2). Computing the overall decision separately from criterion-level decisions can possibly reduce hallucinations, falsely judged screening decisions, and allows for additional flexibility (RQ2).
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们将阐述本文与 Huotala 等人（2025a）的研究之间的差异。 首先，所评估的大型语言模型仅涵盖单代模型、提示词和输出格式，因此尚不清楚更新的大语言模型、不同的用户提示词或输出格式是否还能进一步提升筛选效果，并使使用大型语言模型进行论文筛选成为可行。 早期代次模型的结论可能不再能准确反映更新模型在论文筛选方面的能力；对更多大型语言模型进行基准测试，将有助于研究人员和实践者选择一种在该任务上性能可接受且成本效益高的模型（研究问题1–研究问题2）。 在完整数据集（N = 34,528）上对大型语言模型进行基准测试可能并不经济合理，因为运行大型语言模型通常成本高昂（Felizardo 等人，2025），且由于推理时的测试过程以及思考模型等新增模型能力，大型语言模型的令牌成本有所上升（研究问题1.2）。 将整体决策与准则层面的决策分开计算，可能有助于减少幻觉和误判的筛选结果，同时也能带来更大的灵活性（研究问题2）。

sents.en: Next we explain the difference between this paper and Huotala et al. (2025a) .
sents.zh: 接下来，我们将阐述本文与 Huotala 等人（2025a）的研究之间的差异。

sents.en: First, the evaluated LLMs covered only a single generation of models, prompt, and an output schema, which leaves it unclear whether newer LLMs, different user prompts or output schemas would further improve screening performance and make paper screening feasible with LLMs.
sents.zh: 首先，所评估的大型语言模型仅涵盖单代模型、提示词和输出格式，因此尚不清楚更新的大语言模型、不同的用户提示词或输出格式是否还能进一步提升筛选效果，并使使用大型语言模型进行论文筛选成为可行。

sents.en: Claims of earlier generation models may no longer accurately reflect the capabilities of newer models in paper screening, and benchmarking additional LLMs for paper screening benefit researchers and practitioners in choosing a cost-efficient LLM with an acceptable performance for the task (RQ1 – RQ2).
sents.zh: 早期代次模型的结论可能不再能准确反映更新模型在论文筛选方面的能力；对更多大型语言模型进行基准测试，将有助于研究人员和实践者选择一种在该任务上性能可接受且成本效益高的模型（研究问题1–研究问题2）。

sents.en: Benchmarking LLMs on a full dataset (N = 34,528) may not be financially sensible, as LLMs are generally expensive to run ( Felizardo et al., 2025 ) , and token costs of LLMs have increased due to test-time inference and additional model capabilities, such as thinking models (RQ1.2).
sents.zh: 在完整数据集（N = 34,528）上对大型语言模型进行基准测试可能并不经济合理，因为运行大型语言模型通常成本高昂（Felizardo 等人，2025），且由于推理时的测试过程以及思考模型等新增模型能力，大型语言模型的令牌成本有所上升（研究问题1.2）。

sents.en: Computing the overall decision separately from criterion-level decisions can possibly reduce hallucinations, falsely judged screening decisions, and allows for additional flexibility (RQ2).
sents.zh: 将整体决策与准则层面的决策分开计算，可能有助于减少幻觉和误判的筛选结果，同时也能带来更大的灵活性（研究问题2）。

paragraphs.en: Second, the agreement in overall screening decisions and across inclusion and exclusion criteria was not analyzed in the paper, even though it could reveal whether LLM screening decisions are uniform across different models, or sensitive to the selected model (RQ3.1 – RQ3.2).
paragraphs.zh: 其次，尽管该协议本可以揭示 LLM 的筛选决策在不同模型之间是否一致，或者是否会因所选模型的不同而敏感（RQ3.1 – RQ3.2），但论文并未分析整体筛选决策以及纳入和排除标准方面的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Third, the modification of inclusion and exclusion criteria was not studied in the paper, even when certain criteria cannot possibly be evaluated purely by title and abstract. Improving poorly formatted, unclear, or ambiguous criteria may increase the likelihood of a correct overall or criterion screening decision, which directly motivates RQ4.
paragraphs.zh: 第三，该论文并未研究纳入和排除标准的修改问题，即便某些标准显然无法仅通过标题和摘要进行评估。 改进格式不佳、表述不清或模棱两可的标准，可能会提高整体或单项标准筛选决策的正确性，这直接引出了研究问题4（RQ4）。

sents.en: Third, the modification of inclusion and exclusion criteria was not studied in the paper, even when certain criteria cannot possibly be evaluated purely by title and abstract.
sents.zh: 第三，该论文并未研究纳入和排除标准的修改问题，即便某些标准显然无法仅通过标题和摘要进行评估。

sents.en: Improving poorly formatted, unclear, or ambiguous criteria may increase the likelihood of a correct overall or criterion screening decision, which directly motivates RQ4.
sents.zh: 改进格式不佳、表述不清或模棱两可的标准，可能会提高整体或单项标准筛选决策的正确性，这直接引出了研究问题4（RQ4）。

paragraphs.en: We therefore address the following research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们提出以下研究问题：

paragraphs.en: RQ1: How do LLMs perform in paper screening?
paragraphs.zh: 问题1：大型语言模型在论文筛选方面的表现如何？

paragraphs.en: RQ1.1: How do LLMs perform in paper screening on the full SESR-Eval dataset?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1.1：在完整的 SESR-Eval 数据集上，LLM 在论文筛选任务中的表现如何？

paragraphs.en: RQ1.2: How do LLMs perform in paper screening on the sampled SESR-Eval-Mini dataset?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1.2：在采样的 SESR-Eval-Mini 数据集上，LLM 在论文筛选任务中的表现如何？

paragraphs.en: RQ2: How does computing the overall screening decision from criterion-level decisions affect LLM screening performance on the sampled data?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题2：从准则级决策计算整体筛选决策，会对大语言模型在采样数据上的筛选性能产生何种影响？

paragraphs.en: RQ3: To what extent do LLMs agree with each other?
paragraphs.zh: 问题3：大型语言模型之间在多大程度上达成一致？

paragraphs.en: RQ3.1: To what extent do LLMs agree with each other in their overall screening decisions?
paragraphs.zh: RQ3.1：在整体筛选决策方面，大型语言模型（LLM）之间在多大程度上达成一致？

paragraphs.en: RQ3.2: To what extent do LLMs agree with each other in individual screening criteria?
paragraphs.zh: RQ3.2：在各项个体筛选标准上，LLM 之间的共识程度如何？

paragraphs.en: RQ4: To what extent does refining the inclusion and exclusion criteria affect LLM screening performance?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题4：优化纳入和排除标准在多大程度上会影响大型语言模型（LLM）的筛选效果？

paragraphs.en: For RQ1, we benchmark eight new state-of-the-art LLMs against seven older ones. On the full dataset (RQ1.1), we benchmark two of the new LLMs, and all eight new LLMs on a smaller 5% sample, SESR-Eval-Mini (RQ1.2). We then investigate how prompt design and output structuring affect screening performance in RQ2. For RQ3, we analyze agreement in overall screening decisions across LLMs (RQ3.1) and also across individual inclusion and exclusion criteria (RQ3.2). Finally, for RQ4, we examine whether refining the inclusion and exclusion criteria improves screening performance.
paragraphs.zh: 针对研究问题1（RQ1），我们将八款新的顶尖大语言模型与七款旧模型进行了基准对比。 在完整数据集上（RQ1.1），我们对两款新的大语言模型进行了基准测试；而在一个较小的5%样本集SESR-Eval-Mini上，则对全部八款新模型进行了测试（RQ1.2）。 接下来，我们在研究问题2（RQ2）中探讨了提示设计和输出结构化如何影响筛选表现。 针对研究问题3（RQ3），我们分析了各款大语言模型在整体筛选决策上的一致性（RQ3.1），以及在各条具体纳入和排除标准上的一致性（RQ3.2）。 最后，针对研究问题4（RQ4），我们检验了优化纳入和排除标准是否能够提升筛选表现。

sents.en: For RQ1, we benchmark eight new state-of-the-art LLMs against seven older ones.
sents.zh: 针对研究问题1（RQ1），我们将八款新的顶尖大语言模型与七款旧模型进行了基准对比。

sents.en: On the full dataset (RQ1.1), we benchmark two of the new LLMs, and all eight new LLMs on a smaller 5% sample, SESR-Eval-Mini (RQ1.2).
sents.zh: 在完整数据集上（RQ1.1），我们对两款新的大语言模型进行了基准测试；而在一个较小的5%样本集SESR-Eval-Mini上，则对全部八款新模型进行了测试（RQ1.2）。

sents.en: We then investigate how prompt design and output structuring affect screening performance in RQ2.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们在研究问题2（RQ2）中探讨了提示设计和输出结构化如何影响筛选表现。

sents.en: For RQ3, we analyze agreement in overall screening decisions across LLMs (RQ3.1) and also across individual inclusion and exclusion criteria (RQ3.2).
sents.zh: 针对研究问题3（RQ3），我们分析了各款大语言模型在整体筛选决策上的一致性（RQ3.1），以及在各条具体纳入和排除标准上的一致性（RQ3.2）。

sents.en: Finally, for RQ4, we examine whether refining the inclusion and exclusion criteria improves screening performance.
sents.zh: 最后，针对研究问题4（RQ4），我们检验了优化纳入和排除标准是否能够提升筛选表现。

(2024) , health technology assessment ( Józwiak et al., 2026 ; Qiu et al., 2026 ) , veterinary medicine ( Sujau et al., 2025 ) , and artificial intelligence ( Behrouzian et al., 2026 ) . Next, we first go over software engineering studies, followed by studies from other disciplines, and conclude with a summary on the related work.

paragraphs.en: Huotala et al. (2024) found that GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 LLMs perform as well as Master’s students in paper screening. By simplifying abstracts they were faster to read, but simplification did not increase human performance. GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 LLMs had a precision and recall of (0.650, 0.176) and (0.500, 0.417), respectively. Including task examples in the screening task (one-shot (OS) and few-shot (FS)) was observed to improve screening performance, but the authors must have a list of high-quality seed papers to start with. The usage of prompt optimization was recommended.
paragraphs.zh: Huotala 等人 (2024) 发现，GPT-3.5 和 GPT-4 大型语言模型在论文筛选方面的表现与硕士水平学生相当。 通过简化摘要，阅读速度有所提升，但简化并未提高人类的表现。 GPT-3.5 和 GPT-4 大型语言模型的精确率和召回率分别为 (0.650, 0.176) 和 (0.500, 0.417)。 在筛选任务中加入任务示例（单样本（OS）和少样本（FS））被观察到能够提升筛选表现，但作者必须首先拥有一份高质量种子论文列表。 建议采用提示优化方法。

paragraphs.en: Huotala et al. (2025a) created the SESR-Eval benchmark dataset for benchmarking LLMs in paper screening, and nine LLMs were benchmarked in paper screening using the dataset. Most LLMs performed similarly in paper screening, and the performance differences between secondary studies were greater than for LLMs. GPT-4.1 mini performed the best, but small models, such as Ministral 8B and GPT-4.1 Nano, had poor screening performance. The cost of using LLMs to screen papers was relatively low. The authors concluded that LLMs are not yet recommended for automating paper screening, since accuracy varied widely across secondary studies, and as no LLM managed a high recall with reasonable precision.
paragraphs.zh: Huotala 等人 (2025a) 创建了用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）在论文筛选方面表现的 SESR-Eval 基准数据集，并使用该数据集对九种 LLM 进行了论文筛选能力的测试。 大多数 LLM 在论文筛选中的表现相似，而二次研究之间的性能差异则大于 LLM 之间的差异。 GPT-4.1 mini 的表现最佳，但小型模型（如 Ministral 8B 和 GPT-4.1 Nano）的筛选效果较差。 使用 LLM 进行论文筛选的成本相对较低。 作者得出结论：目前尚不建议使用 LLM 自动化论文筛选，因为不同二次研究中的准确率差异较大，且没有任何一种 LLM 能够在保持合理精度的同时实现较高的召回率。

paragraphs.en: Felizardo et al. (2024) evaluated the accuracy of GPT-4 (ChatGPT) in paper screening for two SRs. They replicated the first selection phase of two SRs with the help of ChatGPT, where the LLMs’ screening results were compared to those of humans. The results were that the overall accuracy in paper screening was 80.7%, and that in both SRs the LLMs made false judgments regarding included and excluded papers. For the first SR, there were 16 false negatives (FN) and 17 false positives (FP). For the second SR, there were 35 FNs and 27 FPs. The recommendation was not to rely completely on LLMs for paper screening, but LLMs can be a valuable tool with SRs as they can mitigate bias and inaccuracies in the included evidence.
paragraphs.zh: Felizardo 等人 (2024) 评估了 GPT-4（ChatGPT）在两项系统综述（SR）中的论文筛选准确性。 他们在 ChatGPT 的帮助下重复了这两项系统综述的首个筛选阶段，并将大型语言模型（LLM）的筛选结果与人类的筛选结果进行了比较。 结果显示，论文筛选的总体准确率为 80.7%，并且在两项系统综述中，LLM 对纳入和排除的论文都做出了错误判断。 在第一项系统综述中，出现了 16 例假阴性（FN）和 17 例假阳性（FP）。 在第二项系统综述中，出现了 35 例假阴性和 27 例假阳性。 研究建议不要完全依赖大型语言模型进行论文筛选，但在系统综述中，LLM 可以成为有价值的工具，因为它们能够减轻纳入证据中的偏见和错误。

paragraphs.en: Li et al. (2024) selected benchmark datasets from the SYNERGY dataset. Using that data, they benchmarked nine LLMs in terms of overall accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity. The results of the LLMs were then compared to gold-standard human decisions. The performance of LLMs varied significantly, but GPT-4 demonstrated a good balance of sensitivity and specificity and the accuracy was consistently in the high 90%s. This indicates a high potential for LLMs in paper screening tasks, but they are not yet ready to fully replace humans in the task.
paragraphs.zh: Li 等人 (2024) 从 SYNERGY 数据集中选择了基准数据集。 他们利用这些数据，从整体准确率、敏感性和特异性方面对九种大型语言模型进行了基准测试。 随后，将大型语言模型的结果与金标准的人类决策进行了比较。 大型语言模型的表现差异显著，但 GPT-4 在敏感性和特异性之间展现了良好的平衡，且其准确率始终保持在 90% 以上的高水平。 这表明大型语言模型在论文筛选任务中具有巨大潜力，但它们尚未准备好完全取代人类完成该任务。

paragraphs.en: Delgado-Chaves et al. (2025) benchmarked 18 LLMs in paper screening. They picked three existing SRs, from which about 6,500 primary studies were evaluated by 18 different LLMs. From the primary studies, 92%, 88%, and 40% of the papers were correctly classified by the LLMs, respectively. There was a significant variation between secondary studies, and the structure of the inclusion and exclusion criteria significantly affected the performance of LLMs in the task. The best-performing LLMs in terms of Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC) were GPT-4o (MCC=0.349) and GPT-4o mini (MCC=0.342). The authors emphasized that extra caution should be taken when articulating inclusion and exclusion criteria. A workload reduction between 33% and 93% was observed during paper screening.
paragraphs.zh: Delgado-Chaves 等人 (2025) 在论文筛选任务中对 18 种大型语言模型（LLM）进行了基准测试。 他们选择了三种现有的二次研究（SR），其中约 6,500 篇原始研究论文由 18 种不同的大型语言模型进行了评估。 在这些原始研究中，大型语言模型对论文的准确分类率分别为 92%、88% 和 40%。 不同二次研究之间的表现存在显著差异，且纳入与排除标准的结构对大型语言模型在该任务中的性能产生了显著影响。 在 Matthews 相关系数（MCC）方面，表现最佳的大型语言模型是 GPT-4o（MCC=0.349）和 GPT-4o mini（MCC=0.342）。 作者强调，在明确纳入与排除标准时，应格外谨慎。 在论文筛选过程中，观察到的工作量减少了 33% 至 93%。

paragraphs.en: Shameem et al. (2026) followed a mixed-methods research to benchmark LLMs on multiple phases of SRs - including formulating research questions, generating search strings, quality assessment, developing taxonomies, and paper screening. First, they selected four SRs as "benchmark studies" (BS), and GPT-4o was used to screen the relevant papers. For all benchmark studies (BS1, BS2, BS3, BS4), GPT-4o correctly classified 64.5%, 68%, 58%, and 72% of papers correctly, respectively. Recall was 55.17%, 50%, 100%, and 72%, for the respective benchmark studies. Precision was 76.1%, 31.2%, 55.3%, and 72%, respectively. However, there were certain domain-specific challenges (e.g., domain-specific literature) that humans would have identified, but the LLM failed to do so.
paragraphs.zh: Shameem 等人 （2026）采用混合方法研究，对大型语言模型（LLM）在系统综述（SR）的多个阶段进行了基准测试——包括研究问题的构建、搜索字符串的生成、质量评估、分类体系的建立以及文献筛选。 首先，他们选择了四篇系统综述作为“基准研究”（BS），并使用 GPT-4o 对相关文献进行筛选。 在所有基准研究（BS1、BS2、BS3、BS4）中，GPT-4o 正确分类的文献比例分别为 64.5%、68%、58% 和 72%。 各项基准研究的召回率分别为 55.17%、50%、100% 和 72%。 各项基准研究的精确率分别为 76.1%、31.2%、55.3% 和 72%。 然而，也存在某些领域特定的挑战（例如领域特定文献），人类本可以识别出来，但大型语言模型却未能做到。

sents.en: Shameem et al.
sents.zh: Shameem 等人

sents.en: (2026) followed a mixed-methods research to benchmark LLMs on multiple phases of SRs - including formulating research questions, generating search strings, quality assessment, developing taxonomies, and paper screening.
sents.zh: （2026）采用混合方法研究，对大型语言模型（LLM）在系统综述（SR）的多个阶段进行了基准测试——包括研究问题的构建、搜索字符串的生成、质量评估、分类体系的建立以及文献筛选。

sents.en: First, they selected four SRs as "benchmark studies" (BS), and GPT-4o was used to screen the relevant papers.
sents.zh: 首先，他们选择了四篇系统综述作为“基准研究”（BS），并使用 GPT-4o 对相关文献进行筛选。

sents.en: For all benchmark studies (BS1, BS2, BS3, BS4), GPT-4o correctly classified 64.5%, 68%, 58%, and 72% of papers correctly, respectively.
sents.zh: 在所有基准研究（BS1、BS2、BS3、BS4）中，GPT-4o 正确分类的文献比例分别为 64.5%、68%、58% 和 72%。

sents.en: Recall was 55.17%, 50%, 100%, and 72%, for the respective benchmark studies.
sents.zh: 各项基准研究的召回率分别为 55.17%、50%、100% 和 72%。

sents.en: Precision was 76.1%, 31.2%, 55.3%, and 72%, respectively.
sents.zh: 各项基准研究的精确率分别为 76.1%、31.2%、55.3% 和 72%。

sents.en: However, there were certain domain-specific challenges (e.g., domain-specific literature) that humans would have identified, but the LLM failed to do so.
sents.zh: 然而，也存在某些领域特定的挑战（例如领域特定文献），人类本可以识别出来，但大型语言模型却未能做到。

paragraphs.en: Thode et al. (2025) benchmarked five LLMs in paper screening, and used the SR’s labeled studies as the ground truth. They designed three different prompts for the task. In addition, they created a dual-LLM system to test how a two-reviewer screening workflow would work with LLMs. As a result, LLMs exhibited a high recall (up to 98%) but low precision (27%). The dual-LLM system managed an average recall of 99% with a precision of 27%. The best-performing LLM was Meta Llama 2 with an average recall of 98%, while GPT-4 Turbo had the highest average precision (72%).
paragraphs.zh: Thode 等人 （2025）在论文筛选任务中对五种大型语言模型进行了基准测试，并使用 SR 标注的研究作为基准真相。 他们为该任务设计了三种不同的提示词。 此外，他们还构建了一个双 LLM 系统，以测试两名评审员参与的筛选流程与 LLM 结合时的效果。 结果表明，大型语言模型展现出较高的召回率（最高可达 98%），但精确率较低（27%）。 该双 LLM 系统实现了平均 99% 的召回率和 27% 的精确率。 表现最佳的大型语言模型是 Meta Llama 2，其平均召回率为 98%，而 GPT-4 Turbo 的平均精确率最高（72%）。

paragraphs.en: Dennstädt et al. (2024) used LLMs to screen papers based on the predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria and the paper’s title and abstract. The performance of LLMs in paper screening varied depending on the LLM being used and on the dataset. FlanT5 was the best-performing model with sensitivity (recall / true positive rate) and specificity (true negative rate) of 94.48%/31.78%. OpenHermes-NeuralChat, Mixtral and Platypus 2 were trailing quite a bit behind, with sensitivity/specificity of 97.58%/19.12%, 93%/75.19% and 97.58%/38.34% for the three models, respectively. Even small changes to the user prompt or the Likert scale from 1-5 to 1-10 significantly impacted the screening performance of LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: Dennstädt 等人 (2024) 使用大型语言模型（LLM）根据预定义的纳入和排除标准以及论文标题和摘要对论文进行筛选。 LLM 在论文筛选中的表现因所用 LLM 和数据集的不同而有所差异。 FlanT5 是表现最佳的模型，其灵敏度（召回率/真阳性率）和特异性（真阴性率）分别为 94.48%/31.78%。 OpenHermes-NeuralChat、Mixtral 和 Platypus 2 的表现则明显落后，三者的灵敏度/特异性分别为 97.58%/19.12%、93%/75.19% 和 97.58%/38.34%。 即使对用户提示或李克特量表从 1-5 改为 1-10 进行微小调整，也会显著影响 LLM 的筛选表现。

paragraphs.en: Tran et al. (2023) evaluated the GPT-3.5 Turbo LLM for paper screening by first developing prompts that aim to mimic the process of screening by human researchers. The LLM was tested on 22,666 papers. The LLM in the paper screening task had a sensitivity of 97.1%, but with poor specificity (37.7%). A workload reduction of 65% was observed. While the tested LLM had a good sensitivity, human intervention was recommended because of the poor specificity.
paragraphs.zh: Tran 等人 (2023) 首先设计了旨在模仿人类研究人员筛选过程的提示词，以此评估 GPT-3.5 Turbo 大型语言模型在论文筛选方面的表现。 该大型语言模型在 22,666 篇论文上进行了测试。 在论文筛选任务中，该大型语言模型的灵敏度为 97.1%，但特异性较低（37.7%）。 观察到的工作量减少了 65%。 尽管所测试的大型语言模型表现出良好的灵敏度，但由于其特异性较低，建议由人类进行干预。

paragraphs.en: Matsui et al. (2024) evaluated paper screening with GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 LLMs in two SRs containing 1,381 and 3,146 papers, respectively. Both of the LLMs had a fairly high paper screening throughput - about 110 records per minute. The total screening task was completed in two hours. In the first SR, GPT-3.5 had a sensitivity/specificity of 0.900/0.709 versus GPT-4’s 0.806/0.996. For the second SR, the performance was fairly similar, with sensitivity/specificity of GPT-3.5’s 0.958/0.116 versus GPT-4’s 0.875/0.855. A deeper analysis found that GPT-3.5 excluded papers because of insufficient domain knowledge, while GPT-4 misinterpreted inclusion criteria.
paragraphs.zh: Matsui 等人 (2024) 在两个分别包含 1,381 篇和 3,146 篇论文的 SR 中，使用 GPT-3.5 和 GPT-4 LLM 对论文进行了筛选评估。 这两种 LLM 的论文筛选吞吐量都相当高——约为每分钟 110 条记录。 整个筛选任务在两小时内完成。 在第一个 SR 中，GPT-3.5 的灵敏度/特异性为 0.900/0.709，而 GPT-4 则为 0.806/0.996。 在第二个 SR 中，两者的表现相当相似，GPT-3.5 的灵敏度/特异性为 0.958/0.116，而 GPT-4 则为 0.875/0.855。 更深入的分析发现，GPT-3.5 因缺乏足够的领域知识而排除了部分论文，而 GPT-4 则误解了纳入标准。

paragraphs.en: Guo et al. (2024) benchmarked the GPT-4 LLM in paper screening. They screened over 24,000 title-abstract pairs across six clinical reviews. GPT-4 had an accuracy of 91.0%, F1 score of 0.60, sensitivity of excluded papers of 0.91, and a sensitivity of included papers of 0.76. The agreement between models was high (kappa=0.96) and the LLMs could give justifications for their incorrect classifications. The authors concluded that LLMs have the potential to improve SR efficiency and lead to more accurate and reliable conclusions in medical research.
paragraphs.zh: Guo 等人 (2024) 在论文筛选任务中评估了 GPT-4 大型语言模型。 他们对六篇临床综述中的超过 24,000 对标题摘要进行了筛选。 GPT-4 的准确率为 91.0%，F1 分数为 0.60，被排除论文的敏感度为 0.91，而被纳入论文的敏感度为 0.76。 模型之间的吻合度很高（kappa=0.96），且大型语言模型能够对其错误分类提供解释。 作者得出结论，大型语言模型有潜力提升系统综述的效率，并推动医学研究得出更准确、更可靠的结论。

paragraphs.en: Serretti (2026) developed a fully local LLM pipeline using the open-weight gpt-oss-20b LLM to benchmark title/abstract screening for three SRs. The performance (F1 score) of the LLM in paper screening was 98.9%, 76.0%, and 83.6% for the three SRs, respectively. The findings demonstrate that a fully locally run LLM can support researchers in paper screening.
paragraphs.zh: Serretti (2026) 开发了一套完全本地化的 LLM 流程，使用开放权重的 gpt-oss-20b LLM 对三项系统综述（SR）的标题/摘要筛选进行了基准测试。 在论文筛选方面，该 LLM 的性能（F1 分数）在这三项系统综述中分别为 98.9%、76.0% 和 83.6%。 研究结果表明，完全本地运行的 LLM 能够辅助研究人员进行论文筛选。

sents.en: Serretti (2026) developed a fully local LLM pipeline using the open-weight gpt-oss-20b LLM to benchmark title/abstract screening for three SRs.

paragraphs.en: Trad et al. (2025) evaluated the performance of a commercial paper screening tool called Rayyan, and an LLM-based paper screening system in automating the screening process. Out of 14,439 papers, two thousand papers were used to train the paper classifier of Rayyan. The paper screening performance was analyzed using different thresholds for paper inclusion. While Rayyan performed adequately (exclusion rate of 50.7%-72.1%), the LLM-based screening system was far superior, achieving an exclusion rate of 99.5%, and a workload reduction of 95.5%, as the screening took 25.5 hours. The paper demonstrates that LLM-based screening systems are far superior compared to traditional ML-based systems, such as Rayyan.
paragraphs.zh: Trad 等人 (2025) 评估了一款名为 Rayyan 的商业论文筛选工具以及一个基于 LLM 的论文筛选系统在自动化筛选流程中的表现。 在 14,439 篇论文中，有两千篇论文被用于训练 Rayyan 的论文分类器。 通过设置不同的论文纳入阈值，分析了该论文筛选系统的性能。 尽管 Rayyan 的表现尚可（排除率为 50.7%-72.1%），但基于 LLM 的筛选系统表现远为出色，实现了 99.5% 的排除率和 95.5% 的工作量减少，且整个筛选过程仅需 25.5 小时。 该论文表明，与 Rayyan 等传统机器学习系统相比，基于 LLM 的筛选系统具有显著优势。

paragraphs.en: Adam et al. (2026) conducted a large experiment with 515 different prompts against open-source LLMs (Meta Llama and Mistral) to study how the prompt structure affects screening performance in four SRs from the medical domain. The resulting F1, recall and precision were 27.6%, 83.6% and 18.5%, respectively. The paper screening performance was observed to increase significantly when 1) larger-parameter LLMs were used; 2) the prompt included the title of the SR being conducted; and 3) the prompt included the selection criteria. Screening accuracy decreased when abstracts were used in screening rather than paper titles. The best-performing prompt achieved 72.2% recall and 66.1% specificity. This translated into a workload reduction of around 34.5–37.5%. The paper highlighted that there is a precision-recall tradeoff to be made and the prompt structure significantly affected screening performance.
paragraphs.zh: Adam 等人 (2026) 开展了一项大规模实验，使用 515 个不同的提示词对开源大型语言模型（Meta Llama 和 Mistral）进行测试，以研究提示词结构如何影响医学领域四个系统综述（SR）的筛选效果。 实验得到的 F1、召回率和精确率分别为 27.6%、83.6% 和 18.5%。 研究观察到，在以下情况下，论文筛选效果显著提升：1) 使用参数规模更大的大型语言模型；2) 提示词包含所执行系统综述的标题；3) 提示词包含选择标准。 当使用摘要而非论文标题进行筛选时，筛选准确性有所下降。 表现最佳的提示词实现了 72.2% 的召回率和 66.1% 的特异性。 这相当于将工作量减少了约 34.5%–37.5%。 该论文强调，精确率与召回率之间存在权衡关系，且提示词结构对筛选效果有显著影响。

sents.en: The paper screening performance was observed to increase significantly when 1) larger-parameter LLMs were used; 2) the prompt included the title of the SR being conducted; and 3) the prompt included the selection criteria.

sents.en: Screening accuracy decreased when abstracts were used in screening rather than paper titles.
sents.zh: 当使用摘要而非论文标题进行筛选时，筛选准确性有所下降。

sents.en: The best-performing prompt achieved 72.2% recall and 66.1% specificity.
sents.zh: 表现最佳的提示词实现了 72.2% 的召回率和 66.1% 的特异性。

sents.en: This translated into a workload reduction of around 34.5–37.5%.
sents.zh: 这相当于将工作量减少了约 34.5%–37.5%。

sents.en: The paper highlighted that there is a precision-recall tradeoff to be made and the prompt structure significantly affected screening performance.
sents.zh: 该论文强调，精确率与召回率之间存在权衡关系，且提示词结构对筛选效果有显著影响。

paragraphs.en: Józwiak et al. (2026) benchmarked Gemini 3 Flash and GPT-5.2 LLMs in paper screening and experimented with how prompt optimization could improve paper screening performance. A dataset of 100 papers was constructed from the papers that had the highest inter-model disagreement ratio, and was labeled by experts for the experiment. Prompt optimization improved recall for all LLMs by +3.7% to +37.1%. The best-performing LLM was Gemini 3 Flash with an accuracy of 91%, and F1 score of 81.6%, while costing 25 times less than GPT-5.2 per abstract.
paragraphs.zh: Józwiak 等人 (2026) 在论文筛选任务中对比测试了 Gemini 3 Flash 和 GPT-5.2 大型语言模型，并实验探究了提示优化如何提升论文筛选性能。 研究团队从模型间分歧率最高的论文中构建了一个包含 100 篇论文的数据集，并由专家为实验进行标注。 提示优化使所有大型语言模型的召回率提升了 +3.7% 至 +37.1%。 表现最佳的大型语言模型是 Gemini 3 Flash，其准确率为 91%，F1 分数为 81.6%，且每篇摘要的成本比 GPT-5.2 低 25 倍。

paragraphs.en: Qiu et al. (2026) benchmarked LLMs for paper screening by using a stepwise training framework with three studies - one for each phase. The first study was used to optimize the technical parameters of the experiment with 1000 abstracts and 50 full texts. The second and third studies validated this approach. The LLMs achieved 100% sensitivity and a specificity between 85.6% and 93%. Full-text screening had an accuracy between 82.1% and 96.2%.
paragraphs.zh: Qiu 等人 (2026) 采用一个分阶段训练框架，利用三项研究（每项研究对应一个阶段）对大型语言模型（LLM）在论文筛选方面的性能进行了基准测试。 第一项研究使用 1000 篇摘要和 50 篇全文来优化实验的技术参数。 第二项和第三项研究验证了这一方法的有效性。 这些大型语言模型实现了 100% 的灵敏度，以及 85.6% 至 93% 的特异性。 全文筛选的准确率在 82.1% 到 96.2% 之间。

paragraphs.en: Sujau et al. (2025) evaluated the effectiveness of LLMs to rank primary studies for climate-sensitive zoonotic disease research. The dataset contained 2905 title-abstract pairs that were related to four zoonotic diseases, and a set of paper selection criteria was constructed. Five researchers screened abstracts using the defined criteria. After that, the papers were screened using GPT-4o LLM with zero-shot (ZS) and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting techniques. A workload reduction of at least 70% was achieved, while the LLM maintained a recall of 95%. The authors emphasized that further research is needed on standardized benchmark datasets, but the findings demonstrate that LLMs can substantially reduce the screening effort.
paragraphs.zh: Sujau 等人 (2025) 评估了大型语言模型在气候敏感型人畜共患病研究中筛选初级研究的有效性。 该数据集包含 2905 对与四种人畜共患病相关的标题-摘要，并构建了一套论文筛选标准。 五名研究人员根据既定标准对摘要进行了筛选。 随后，使用 GPT-4o 大型语言模型结合零样本（ZS）和思维链（CoT）提示技术对论文进行了筛选。 实现了至少 70% 的工作量减少，同时大型语言模型的召回率仍保持在 95%。 作者强调，仍需进一步研究标准化基准数据集，但研究结果表明，大型语言模型能够显著降低筛选工作量。

paragraphs.en: Behrouzian et al. (2026) used GPT-5.1 and GPT-3.5 Turbo LLMs to benchmark paper screening against a dataset from the Cochrane review corpus, which contained 1,000 abstracts. The recall of GPT-5.1 and GPT-3.5 Turbo ranged from 0.72 to 0.32 and 0.92 to 0.18, respectively. Excluding papers immediately, rather than labeling papers as unsure, made both models perform better with consistency. This demonstrated that LLMs do not handle uncertainty well in paper screening.
paragraphs.zh: Behrouzian 等人 (2026) 使用 GPT-5.1 和 GPT-3.5 Turbo 大型语言模型，基于包含 1,000 篇摘要的 Cochrane 综述语料库数据集，对论文筛选进行了基准测试。 GPT-5.1 和 GPT-3.5 Turbo 的召回率分别为 0.72 至 0.32 和 0.92 至 0.18。 直接排除论文，而不是将论文标记为不确定，使两种模型的表现都更加一致且更优。 这表明大型语言模型在论文筛选中无法有效处理不确定性。

paragraphs.en: The common consensus of the related work is that LLMs show significant promise in paper screening, by reliably reducing the workload of practitioners and researchers in paper screening tasks, while LLMs have been observed to perform as well as non-expert humans in the task. Despite these promises, LLMs are not yet recommended for fully replacing humans in paper screening, as the screening performance is greatly affected by the structure and clarity of the inclusion and exclusion criteria, the structure of the prompt, certain domain-specific issues, and the trade-off of selecting a cost-effective LLM instead of a state-of-the-art LLM to reduce costs.
paragraphs.zh: 相关研究的普遍共识是，大型语言模型（LLM）在论文筛选方面展现出巨大潜力，能够可靠地减轻从业者和研究人员在论文筛选任务中的工作负担，同时已有观察表明，LLM 在该任务上的表现可与非专家人类相媲美。 尽管存在这些优势，目前仍不建议完全用 LLM 取代人类进行论文筛选，因为筛选效果会受到纳入和排除标准的结构与清晰度、提示词的结构、某些领域特定问题，以及在降低成本时选择经济高效的 LLM 而非顶尖 LLM 之间的权衡等因素的显著影响。

sents.en: Despite these promises, LLMs are not yet recommended for fully replacing humans in paper screening, as the screening performance is greatly affected by the structure and clarity of the inclusion and exclusion criteria, the structure of the prompt, certain domain-specific issues, and the trade-off of selecting a cost-effective LLM instead of a state-of-the-art LLM to reduce costs.
sents.zh: 尽管存在这些优势，目前仍不建议完全用 LLM 取代人类进行论文筛选，因为筛选效果会受到纳入和排除标准的结构与清晰度、提示词的结构、某些领域特定问题，以及在降低成本时选择经济高效的 LLM 而非顶尖 LLM 之间的权衡等因素的显著影响。

paragraphs.en: Existing literature predominantly treats paper screening as a binary classification task, as they examine only the overall screening performance, and provide only a minimal criterion-level analysis of how LLMs handle specific inclusion/exclusion criteria or whether the performance varies across criteria types. Furthermore, only a few studies investigate inter-LLM agreement and the impact of dataset sampling, or how refining criteria affects paper screening performance.
paragraphs.zh: 现有文献主要将论文筛选视为一个二元分类任务，因为它们仅考察整体筛选表现，并且仅对大型语言模型（LLM）如何处理特定的纳入/排除标准，或不同标准类型间表现是否存在差异，提供最低限度的标准层面分析。 此外，仅有少数研究探讨了不同大型语言模型之间的一致性、数据集采样所带来的影响，以及优化标准如何影响论文筛选表现。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we introduce the core concepts for this study. First, we describe the paper screening process in SRs. Then, we describe paper screening as a classification task, and how the criterion-level decisions are aggregated into an overall screening decision. Finally, we discuss the agreement between multiple screeners.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将介绍本研究的核心概念。 首先，我们描述 SRs 中的论文筛选流程。 接着，我们将论文筛选描述为一个分类任务，并说明如何基于标准层面的决策汇总得出整体的筛选结果。 最后，我们将讨论多位筛选者之间的一致性。

sents.en: In this section, we introduce the core concepts for this study.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们将介绍本研究的核心概念。

sents.en: First, we describe the paper screening process in SRs.
sents.zh: 首先，我们描述 SRs 中的论文筛选流程。

sents.en: Then, we describe paper screening as a classification task, and how the criterion-level decisions are aggregated into an overall screening decision.
sents.zh: 接着，我们将论文筛选描述为一个分类任务，并说明如何基于标准层面的决策汇总得出整体的筛选结果。

sents.en: Finally, we discuss the agreement between multiple screeners.
sents.zh: 最后，我们将讨论多位筛选者之间的一致性。

paragraphs.en: In SRs, inclusion (IC) and/or exclusion (EC) criteria are applied to research papers’ titles and abstracts to determine whether the paper should be included or excluded ( Kitchenham and Charters, 2007 ) . Excluded papers are discarded, and the remaining included papers are further examined in the full-text screening phase ( Kitchenham and Charters, 2007 ) . Each of these criteria map to a specific research question (RQ) of the study, so the selected primary studies have the possibility to contain an answer to the RQ. The SR guidelines state that the criteria should be crafted during the SR protocol development, and may be refined during the literature search process ( Kitchenham and Charters, 2007 ) . Importantly, criteria should be formulated so that they can be reliably assessed and classify studies with high accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 在系统综述（SR）中，会针对研究论文的标题和摘要应用纳入标准（IC）和/或排除标准（EC），以判断该论文是否应被纳入或排除（Kitchenham 和 Charters，2007）。 被排除的论文将被舍弃，而剩余的纳入论文则会在全文筛选阶段接受进一步审查（Kitchenham 和 Charters，2007）。 这些标准每一项都对应研究中的某个具体研究问题（RQ），因此所选的主要研究有可能包含对该研究问题的答案。 系统综述指南指出，相关标准应在系统综述方案制定期间设计，并可能在文献检索过程中进行完善（Kitchenham 和 Charters，2007）。 重要的是，标准的制定应确保其能够被可靠地评估，并能以高准确性对研究进行分类。

paragraphs.en: Some inclusion and exclusion criteria may be applied to the paper’s metadata, such as language, date of publication, and publisher information. While human researchers can easily determine whether a paper was published in a certain year or period, LLMs can have issues making such decisions without having access to the paper’s metadata or, in some cases, the publisher’s copyright statement in the abstract ( Felizardo et al., 2025 ) . In addition, it is noted that criteria that assess the language of the paper, or are biased towards the knowledge of the authors, can influence the decisions based on the criteria ( Kitchenham and Charters, 2007 ; Kitchenham et al., 2004 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 可能会对论文的元数据应用一些纳入和排除标准，例如语言、发表日期和出版商信息。 虽然人类研究人员可以轻松判断一篇论文是否在某一年或某个时期发表，但大型语言模型（LLM）在无法访问论文元数据或某些情况下无法访问摘要中出版商的版权声明时，可能会难以做出此类判断（Felizardo 等，2025）。 此外，值得注意的是，评估论文语言或偏向作者知识水平的标准，可能会影响基于这些标准的决策（Kitchenham 和 Charters，2007；Kitchenham 等，2004）。

paragraphs.en: The implications of these observations raise important questions regarding how LLMs handle screening based on a set of rules. First, since inclusion and exclusion criteria have differences in how they can be assessed objectively, decisions made by LLMs can be more consistent with certain criteria than with others. This motivates RQ3, where we analyze how LLM screening decisions actually agree across paper selection criteria (RQ3.2). Second, as Kitchenham and Charters (2007) states that the criteria may be refined during the literature search process, it remains uncharted whether such refinement also improves the performance of LLMs in paper screening. This motivates our RQ4, which investigates the effect of refining the paper selection criteria on LLM screening performance.
paragraphs.zh: 这些观察结果的潜在影响引发了关于大型语言模型（LLM）如何根据一系列规则执行筛选的重要问题。 首先，由于纳入和排除标准在客观评估方式上存在差异，LLM 做出的决策可能与某些标准更为一致，而非与其他标准一致。 这促使我们提出研究问题 3（RQ3），即分析 LLM 的筛选决策在不同论文选择标准之间实际的一致性程度（RQ3.2）。 其次，正如 Kitchenham 和 Charters（2007）所指出的，相关标准可能在文献检索过程中得到优化，但此类优化是否也能提升 LLM 在论文筛选方面的表现，仍是一个未解之谜。 这促使我们提出研究问题 4（RQ4），旨在探究优化论文选择标准对 LLM 筛选性能的影响。

sents.en: The implications of these observations raise important questions regarding how LLMs handle screening based on a set of rules.
sents.zh: 这些观察结果的潜在影响引发了关于大型语言模型（LLM）如何根据一系列规则执行筛选的重要问题。

sents.en: First, since inclusion and exclusion criteria have differences in how they can be assessed objectively, decisions made by LLMs can be more consistent with certain criteria than with others.
sents.zh: 首先，由于纳入和排除标准在客观评估方式上存在差异，LLM 做出的决策可能与某些标准更为一致，而非与其他标准一致。

sents.en: This motivates RQ3, where we analyze how LLM screening decisions actually agree across paper selection criteria (RQ3.2).
sents.zh: 这促使我们提出研究问题 3（RQ3），即分析 LLM 的筛选决策在不同论文选择标准之间实际的一致性程度（RQ3.2）。

sents.en: Second, as Kitchenham and Charters (2007) states that the criteria may be refined during the literature search process, it remains uncharted whether such refinement also improves the performance of LLMs in paper screening.
sents.zh: 其次，正如 Kitchenham 和 Charters（2007）所指出的，相关标准可能在文献检索过程中得到优化，但此类优化是否也能提升 LLM 在论文筛选方面的表现，仍是一个未解之谜。

sents.en: This motivates our RQ4, which investigates the effect of refining the paper selection criteria on LLM screening performance.
sents.zh: 这促使我们提出研究问题 4（RQ4），旨在探究优化论文选择标准对 LLM 筛选性能的影响。

paragraphs.en: Title-abstract screening (paper screening) can be considered a binary classification task ( Du et al., 2024 ; van de Schoot et al., 2021 ) , where each paper is either included or excluded based on its title and abstract ( Kitchenham and Charters, 2007 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 标题-摘要筛选（论文筛选）可被视为一项二元分类任务（Du et al., 2024；van de Schoot et al., 2021），其中每篇论文将根据其标题和摘要被纳入或排除（Kitchenham and Charters, 2007）。

paragraphs.en: However, SRs typically include multiple inclusion and exclusion criteria, and the overall inclusion/exclusion decision depends on how individual criterion-level decisions are combined or aggregated. A common pattern is that a paper is excluded if it matches even one exclusion criterion, or if it does not match every inclusion criterion. However, variations of these rule combinations do exist. This complexity of handling multiple criteria raises important questions about inter-screener agreement, and how criterion-level decisions should be aggregated. This also motivates our RQ3.1 and RQ3.2.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，SRs 通常包含多个纳入和排除标准，而整体的纳入/排除决策取决于各项标准层面的决策如何被组合或汇总。 一种常见模式是：如果一篇论文符合哪怕一条排除标准，或者不符合所有纳入标准，则会被排除。 不过，这些规则组合确实存在变体。 处理多个标准的这种复杂性引发了关于筛查员间一致性以及标准层面决策应如何汇总的重要问题。 这也促使我们提出了 RQ3.1 和 RQ3.2。

sents.en: However, SRs typically include multiple inclusion and exclusion criteria, and the overall inclusion/exclusion decision depends on how individual criterion-level decisions are combined or aggregated.
sents.zh: 然而，SRs 通常包含多个纳入和排除标准，而整体的纳入/排除决策取决于各项标准层面的决策如何被组合或汇总。

sents.en: A common pattern is that a paper is excluded if it matches even one exclusion criterion, or if it does not match every inclusion criterion.
sents.zh: 一种常见模式是：如果一篇论文符合哪怕一条排除标准，或者不符合所有纳入标准，则会被排除。

sents.en: However, variations of these rule combinations do exist.
sents.zh: 不过，这些规则组合确实存在变体。

sents.en: This complexity of handling multiple criteria raises important questions about inter-screener agreement, and how criterion-level decisions should be aggregated.
sents.zh: 处理多个标准的这种复杂性引发了关于筛查员间一致性以及标准层面决策应如何汇总的重要问题。

sents.en: This also motivates our RQ3.1 and RQ3.2.
sents.zh: 这也促使我们提出了 RQ3.1 和 RQ3.2。

paragraphs.en: When LLMs are applied in paper screening, a common pattern is that the LLM produces an overall decision in binary format. This binary classification task can be expanded to support probabilistic (a floating point between 0.0 and 1.0), or e.g., Likert-scale decisions ( Felizardo et al., 2024 ; Huotala et al., 2025a ) . The aggregation behind the overall decision of the LLM can be done in two ways.
paragraphs.zh: 当大型语言模型（LLM）应用于论文筛选时，一种常见模式是 LLM 以二元格式生成总体决策。 这种二元分类任务可以扩展为支持概率性决策（0.0 到 1.0 之间的浮点数），或例如李克特量表决策（Felizardo et al., 2024; Huotala et al., 2025a）。 LLM 总体决策背后的聚合可以通过两种方式进行。

sents.en: When LLMs are applied in paper screening, a common pattern is that the LLM produces an overall decision in binary format.
sents.zh: 当大型语言模型（LLM）应用于论文筛选时，一种常见模式是 LLM 以二元格式生成总体决策。

sents.en: This binary classification task can be expanded to support probabilistic (a floating point between 0.0 and 1.0), or e.g., Likert-scale decisions ( Felizardo et al., 2024 ; Huotala et al., 2025a ) .
sents.zh: 这种二元分类任务可以扩展为支持概率性决策（0.0 到 1.0 之间的浮点数），或例如李克特量表决策（Felizardo et al., 2024; Huotala et al., 2025a）。

sents.en: The aggregation behind the overall decision of the LLM can be done in two ways.
sents.zh: LLM 总体决策背后的聚合可以通过两种方式进行。

paragraphs.en: In the first way, the LLM produces judgments for each criterion and also the overall decision. This adds a considerable amount of flexibility, but there is an issue. Because most LLMs are decoder-only transformers ( Vaswani et al., 2023 ) , they predict the next token(s) based on the earlier tokens, the overall decision may contradict the LLM’s own criterion-level judgments, if e.g., the overall decision is generated before the criterion-level decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 在第一种方法中，LLM 会针对每个标准生成判断，同时也会生成总体决策。 这增加了相当大的灵活性，但存在一个问题。 由于大多数 LLM 都是仅解码器型的 Transformer（Vaswani 等人，2023），它们会根据前面的词元预测下一个或几个词元；因此，如果总体决策在标准层面的决策之前生成，总体决策可能与 LLM 自身在标准层面的判断相矛盾。

sents.en: In the first way, the LLM produces judgments for each criterion and also the overall decision.
sents.zh: 在第一种方法中，LLM 会针对每个标准生成判断，同时也会生成总体决策。

sents.en: This adds a considerable amount of flexibility, but there is an issue.
sents.zh: 这增加了相当大的灵活性，但存在一个问题。

sents.en: Because most LLMs are decoder-only transformers ( Vaswani et al., 2023 ) , they predict the next token(s) based on the earlier tokens, the overall decision may contradict the LLM’s own criterion-level judgments, if e.g., the overall decision is generated before the criterion-level decisions.
sents.zh: 由于大多数 LLM 都是仅解码器型的 Transformer（Vaswani 等人，2023），它们会根据前面的词元预测下一个或几个词元；因此，如果总体决策在标准层面的决策之前生成，总体决策可能与 LLM 自身在标准层面的判断相矛盾。

paragraphs.en: In the second way, the LLM produces only the judgments for the criteria, and the overall decision is aggregated manually from the judgments of the criteria. The benefit here is that the decision boundary can be adjusted flexibly, if one wants to e.g., maximize recall ( Huotala et al., 2025a ) . However, if a study has a significant number of criteria, a single incorrect criterion judgment is enough to falsely exclude a possibly relevant paper. This trade-off here motivates RQ2.
paragraphs.zh: 在第二种方法中，LLM 仅生成各标准项的判断结果，而最终决策则通过人工汇总这些判断结果得出。 这种方法的优势在于，如果希望（例如）最大化召回率，就可以灵活调整决策边界（Huotala 等人，2025a）。 然而，如果一项研究包含大量标准项，那么仅一个错误的标准项判断就足以错误地排除一篇可能相关的论文。 这种权衡关系正是 RQ2 的研究动机所在。

sents.en: In the second way, the LLM produces only the judgments for the criteria, and the overall decision is aggregated manually from the judgments of the criteria.
sents.zh: 在第二种方法中，LLM 仅生成各标准项的判断结果，而最终决策则通过人工汇总这些判断结果得出。

sents.en: The benefit here is that the decision boundary can be adjusted flexibly, if one wants to e.g., maximize recall ( Huotala et al., 2025a ) .
sents.zh: 这种方法的优势在于，如果希望（例如）最大化召回率，就可以灵活调整决策边界（Huotala 等人，2025a）。

sents.en: However, if a study has a significant number of criteria, a single incorrect criterion judgment is enough to falsely exclude a possibly relevant paper.
sents.zh: 然而，如果一项研究包含大量标准项，那么仅一个错误的标准项判断就足以错误地排除一篇可能相关的论文。

sents.en: This trade-off here motivates RQ2.
sents.zh: 这种权衡关系正是 RQ2 的研究动机所在。

paragraphs.en: The standard SR methodology recommends that at least two independent reviewers screen papers, to reduce bias and ensure rigor ( Kitchenham and Charters, 2007 ) . The benefit of multiple reviewers can be formalized by the Condorcet Jury Theorem ( List and Goodin, 2001 ; Shteingart et al., 2020 ) , which demonstrates that when individual decision-makers make the correct binary decision with a higher than 50/50 chance, the accuracy of a majority vote increases as the number of independent decision-makers increases (Figure 1 ) ( List and Goodin, 2001 ; Shteingart et al., 2020 ) . Empirical evidence supports this principle. A study by Abramowitz et al. (2025) found that multiple independent reviewers provide more reliable quality assessment than a single reviewer in peer review contexts.
paragraphs.zh: 标准的 SR 方法论建议至少由两名独立的智能体对论文进行筛选，以减少偏见并确保严谨性（Kitchenham 和 Charters，2007）。 多位智能体参与评审的优势可以通过孔多塞陪审团定理（Condorcet Jury Theorem）（List 和 Goodin，2001；Shteingart 等，2020）进行形式化描述。该定理表明，当个体决策者以高于 50% 的概率做出正确的二元决策时，多数投票的准确性会随着独立决策者数量的增加而提高（图 1）（List 和 Goodin，2001；Shteingart 等，2020）。 实证证据支持这一原则。 Abramowitz 等人的一项研究 （2025）发现，在同行评审情境中，多位独立智能体提供的质量评估比单一智能体更为可靠。

sents.en: The standard SR methodology recommends that at least two independent reviewers screen papers, to reduce bias and ensure rigor ( Kitchenham and Charters, 2007 ) .
sents.zh: 标准的 SR 方法论建议至少由两名独立的智能体对论文进行筛选，以减少偏见并确保严谨性（Kitchenham 和 Charters，2007）。

sents.en: The benefit of multiple reviewers can be formalized by the Condorcet Jury Theorem ( List and Goodin, 2001 ; Shteingart et al., 2020 ) , which demonstrates that when individual decision-makers make the correct binary decision with a higher than 50/50 chance, the accuracy of a majority vote increases as the number of independent decision-makers increases (Figure 1 ) ( List and Goodin, 2001 ; Shteingart et al., 2020 ) .
sents.zh: 多位智能体参与评审的优势可以通过孔多塞陪审团定理（Condorcet Jury Theorem）（List 和 Goodin，2001；Shteingart 等，2020）进行形式化描述。该定理表明，当个体决策者以高于 50% 的概率做出正确的二元决策时，多数投票的准确性会随着独立决策者数量的增加而提高（图 1）（List 和 Goodin，2001；Shteingart 等，2020）。

sents.en: Empirical evidence supports this principle.
sents.zh: 实证证据支持这一原则。

sents.en: A study by Abramowitz et al.
sents.zh: Abramowitz 等人的一项研究

sents.en: (2025) found that multiple independent reviewers provide more reliable quality assessment than a single reviewer in peer review contexts.
sents.zh: （2025）发现，在同行评审情境中，多位独立智能体提供的质量评估比单一智能体更为可靠。

paragraphs.en: Three conditions of the Condorcet Jury Theorem are important when LLMs screen papers. First, the benefit of multiple raters requires a majority. Second, with two LLMs as decision makers, a majority vote cannot resolve a possible disagreement. Using two LLMs to screen is therefore only useful to flag disagreements, or to include a paper if either of the models includes it. This increases recall, but lowers precision. Third, the LLMs making the decisions must reach their decisions independently. It is known that LLMs share much of their training data, so choosing e.g. models from only a single provider might reduce the collaborative usage of these LLMs, and most likely the errors of the LLMs are correlated. A high agreement between LLMs is therefore ambiguous. This might indicate that the LLMs themselves are reliable, or they make the same mistakes, which makes it pointless to use multiple LLMs for screening.
paragraphs.zh: 在大型语言模型（LLM）筛选论文时，孔多塞陪审团定理的三个条件非常重要。 首先，多个评审员带来的优势需要多数票的支持。 其次，当有两个 LLM 作为决策者时，多数投票无法解决可能存在的分歧。 因此，使用两个 LLM 进行筛选仅对标记分歧有用，或者在任一模型都包含某篇论文时将其纳入。 这提高了召回率，但降低了精确度。 第三，做出决策的 LLM 必须独立地得出各自的结论。 众所周知，LLM 共享大量训练数据，因此例如仅选择单一提供商的模型，可能会降低这些 LLM 的协同使用效果，而且 LLM 的错误很可能存在相关性。 因此，LLM 之间的高度一致具有模糊性。 这可能表明 LLM 本身是可靠的，或者它们犯了相同的错误，而后者使得使用多个 LLM 进行筛选毫无意义。

sents.zh: 在大型语言模型（LLM）筛选论文时，孔多塞陪审团定理的三个条件非常重要。

sents.zh: 这提高了召回率，但降低了精确度。

sents.zh: 第三，做出决策的 LLM 必须独立地得出各自的结论。

sents.en: It is known that LLMs share much of their training data, so choosing e.g. models from only a single provider might reduce the collaborative usage of these LLMs, and most likely the errors of the LLMs are correlated.
sents.zh: 众所周知，LLM 共享大量训练数据，因此例如仅选择单一提供商的模型，可能会降低这些 LLM 的协同使用效果，而且 LLM 的错误很可能存在相关性。

sents.en: This might indicate that the LLMs themselves are reliable, or they make the same mistakes, which makes it pointless to use multiple LLMs for screening.
sents.zh: 这可能表明 LLM 本身是可靠的，或者它们犯了相同的错误，而后者使得使用多个 LLM 进行筛选毫无意义。

paragraphs.en: A comprehensive evaluation of LLM reliability requires examining both inter-model agreement and the consistency of decisions across different LLMs and criteria. Such analysis is essential for assessing whether LLMs can reliably replace or augment human screeners in the paper screening phase of SRs. For these reasons, LLM agreement is analyzed between LLMs (RQ3.1) and between inclusion and exclusion criteria (RQ3.2).
paragraphs.zh: 对大型语言模型（LLM）可靠性的全面评估，需要考察模型间的共识性，以及不同 LLM 在不同标准下决策的一致性。 此类分析对于评估 LLM 是否能够在系统回顾（SR）的文献筛选阶段可靠地替代或辅助人类筛选员至关重要。 基于这些原因，本研究分析了 LLM 之间的共识性（研究问题 3.1），以及纳入与排除标准之间的共识性（研究问题 3.2）。

sents.en: A comprehensive evaluation of LLM reliability requires examining both inter-model agreement and the consistency of decisions across different LLMs and criteria.

paragraphs.en: Next, we cover the methodology used in the study. We followed the SIGSOFT empirical standards to conduct this research ( Ralph et al., 2020 ) . The high-level overview of the methodology can be seen in Figure 2 . First, in Subsection 4.1 , we describe how LLMs were selected for the experiments ①. Then, we describe how the data sampling for the SESR-Eval-Mini dataset was conducted in Subsection 4.2 ②. After this, we give a detailed overview of how we benchmarked the LLMs (Subsection 4.3 ), how the computation of the overall screening decision was separated (Subsection 4.4 ), the setup behind the LLM agreement between each other and criteria (Subsection 4.5 ), and the criteria modification process (Subsection 4.6 ). In Subsection 4.7 , we cover the statistical methods used.

paragraphs.en: For the LLM selection ①, we first picked existing LLMs that were benchmarked with the SESR-Eval dataset ( Huotala et al., 2025a ) , excluding Ministral 8B and GPT-4.1 Nano, as they exhibited poor screening performance compared to the rest of the models in the work. Selecting the existing LLMs gives us a good baseline that we can use to directly compare the newer models against.
paragraphs.zh: 在大型语言模型（LLM）的选择①方面，我们首先挑选了已通过 SESR-Eval 数据集进行基准测试的现有 LLM（Huotala et al., 2025a），但排除了 Ministral 8B 和 GPT-4.1 Nano，因为与该研究中的其他模型相比，它们的筛选表现较差。 选择现有 LLM 为我们提供了一个良好的基准，可以直接用于与新模型进行比较。

sents.en: For the LLM selection ①, we first picked existing LLMs that were benchmarked with the SESR-Eval dataset ( Huotala et al., 2025a ) , excluding Ministral 8B and GPT-4.1 Nano, as they exhibited poor screening performance compared to the rest of the models in the work.
sents.zh: 在大型语言模型（LLM）的选择①方面，我们首先挑选了已通过 SESR-Eval 数据集进行基准测试的现有 LLM（Huotala et al., 2025a），但排除了 Ministral 8B 和 GPT-4.1 Nano，因为与该研究中的其他模型相比，它们的筛选表现较差。

sents.zh: 选择现有 LLM 为我们提供了一个良好的基准，可以直接用于与新模型进行比较。

paragraphs.en: In addition to the existing LLMs, we selected some new LLMs from the LiveBench leaderboard by White et al. (2025) (version 2026-01-08 1 1 1 https://web.archive.org/web/20260504142848/https://livebench.ai/#/?highunseenbias=true ), to see how the current state-of-the-art performs in paper screening. LiveBench actively maintains a list of LLMs alongside the performance results in various domains and contexts, including reasoning, coding, mathematics, and data analysis. From the leaderboard, we first picked eight distinct publishers: OpenAI 2 2 2 https://openai.com , Anthropic 3 3 3 https://www.anthropic.com , Google 4 4 4 https://ai.google , Z.AI 5 5 5 https://z.ai , Moonshot AI 6 6 6 https://www.moonshot.ai , SpaceXAI 7 7 7 https://x.ai , Alibaba 8 8 8 https://qwen.ai , DeepSeek 9 9 9 https://deepseek.com – not in any particular order. Next, for each publisher, we selected their LLM with the highest global average performance score to minimize the risk of picking LLMs that fare better in some domain or context. As demonstrated by Huotala et al. (2025a) , selecting the most expensive model does not guarantee an increase in screening performance.
paragraphs.zh: 除了现有的大型语言模型（LLM）之外，我们还从 White 等人（2025）发布的 LiveBench 排行榜（版本：2026-01-08 1 1 1 https://web.archive.org/web/20260504142848/https://livebench.ai/#/?highunseenbias=true ）中挑选了一些新的 LLM，以观察当前最先进的模型在论文筛选方面的表现。LiveBench 会持续维护一份包含各类领域和场景（包括推理、编程、数学和数据分析）的 LLM 性能结果列表。我们从该排行榜中首先挑选了八个不同的发布方：OpenAI 2 2 2 https://openai.com、Anthropic 3 3 3 https://www.anthropic.com、Google 4 4 4 https://ai.google、Z.AI 5 5 5 https://z.ai、Moonshot AI 6 6 6 https://www.moonshot.ai、SpaceXAI 7 7 7 https://x.ai、Alibaba 8 8 8 https://qwen.ai 和 DeepSeek 9 9 9 https://deepseek.com——顺序并不重要。接下来，对于每个发布方，我们选择了其全球平均性能得分最高的 LLM，以尽可能降低因某些模型在特定领域或场景下表现更优而带来的风险。正如 Huotala 等人（2025a）所证明的，选择最昂贵的模型并不一定能提升论文筛选的性能。

paragraphs.en: While most new LLMs were set to a ’low’ reasoning effort, the reasoning effort of DeepSeek V4 Pro and Qwen 3.6 Plus were set to ’high’ and ’medium’, since they were the first LLMs we tested, we mirrored the reasoning effort setting of the existing o3-mini LLM. As we previously demonstrated that "thinking" models give negligible improvements in screening performance when reasoning effort is increased, and that it increases token output significantly ( Huotala et al., 2025a ) , we then decided to configure the rest of the models to a ’low’ reasoning effort.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然大多数新 LLM 的推理努力程度被设为“低”，但 DeepSeek V4 Pro 和 Qwen 3.6 Plus 的推理努力程度则分别设为“高”和“中”。由于它们是首批我们测试的 LLM，因此我们沿用了现有 o3-mini LLM 的推理努力设置。 正如我们此前所证明的，当提高推理努力程度时，“思考”模型在筛选性能上的提升微乎其微，且会显著增加标记输出量（Huotala 等，2025a），因此我们随后决定将其余模型配置为“低”推理努力程度。

paragraphs.en: In total, we selected 15 LLMs for the experiments (Table 2 ) – seven of which were previously benchmarked in the SESR-Eval paper, and eight new LLMs, which represent the current state-of-the-art.
paragraphs.zh: 总的来说，我们为实验选择了 15 个 LLM（见表 2）——其中 7 个曾在 SESR-Eval 论文中接受过基准测试，另外 8 个是新的 LLM，代表了当前的最先进水平。

paragraphs.en: After the LLM selection ①, we continued with data sampling ②. We decided to conduct data sampling, as our main goal was to provide a cheaper alternative of SESR-Eval dataset, which is motivated by Table 2 as it shows that newer flagship models have significantly increased input and output token costs. In addition, we did not want to trade better performance for lower costs by choosing smaller LLMs, which are evidently cheaper ( Felizardo et al., 2025 ) . As the data source, we used SESR-Eval by Huotala et al. (2025a) , which is a gold-standard paper screening dataset. The dataset contains 34,528 pre-labeled primary studies from 24 software engineering secondary studies, which were rigorously sourced from high-reputation SE journals ( Huotala et al., 2025b ) . The labels of the primary studies are the overall screening decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 在选定 LLM ①之后，我们继续进行了数据采样 ②。 我们决定进行数据采样，因为我们的主要目标是提供一个比 SESR-Eval 数据集更便宜的替代方案；表 2 为此提供了依据，因为它显示较新的旗舰模型在输入和输出令牌成本上显著增加。 此外，我们并不希望通过选择明显更便宜但性能更小的 LLM（Felizardo et al., 2025）来以牺牲性能为代价换取更低成本。 作为数据源，我们使用了 Huotala 等人提出的 SESR-Eval。 （2025a），这是一份黄金标准级的论文筛选数据集。 该数据集包含 34,528 项预先标注的一级研究，这些研究来自 24 项软件工程二级研究，且均严格从声誉卓著的软件工程期刊中获取（Huotala et al., 2025b）。 一级研究的标签即为其整体的筛选决策。

paragraphs.en: For the paper sampling strategy, we decided to use power-allocated sampling with α = 0.5 \alpha=0.5 ( Bankier, 1988 ) . Power-allocated sampling balances the proportional and equal allocation to control for variance across strata ( Bankier, 1988 ) . In practice, pure random sampling (a power-allocated sample with an α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 ) at 5% would give us a sample where the smallest secondary study (with 69 primary studies) would get an average of 3.45 primary studies, which would not allow any sort of secondary study-level inference on the accuracy. On the other hand, with an α = 0.0 \alpha=0.0 , all secondary studies would get equal weight, which at 5% would be 72 primary studies for each secondary study ( 34,528 34,528 × \times 0.05 0.05 / 24). This would distort the overall dataset too much in favor of small studies. The value of α = 0.5 \alpha=0.5 is a compromise as it balances between equally allocating across all strata, and allocating proportional to the size of each stratum Bankier (1988) . Table 3 lists the secondary studies, their full primary study count and the sampled primary study count. The full dataset used in the experiments contains 34,528 rows, whereas the 5% sample set contains 1,726 papers. One can notice that the sampled data has a different I:E ratio overall (21:79) than the full dataset (12:88). This is because smaller secondary studies had more inclusions and their proportional weight increases in power-allocated sampling. For RQ4, the subset of studies was further reduced to 448 papers, as we selected only those papers that were part of the seven secondary studies most suitable for criteria improvement ⑤.
paragraphs.zh: 对于论文抽样策略，我们决定使用功率分配抽样法，其中 α = 0.5 \alpha=0.5（Bankier, 1988）。 功率分配抽样法在比例分配与均等分配之间取得平衡，从而控制各分层之间的方差（Bankier, 1988）。 实际上，采用 5% 的纯随机抽样（即 α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 的功率分配样本），最小的次级研究（包含 69 项初级研究）平均将分配到 3.45 项初级研究，这无法支持任何针对准确性的次级研究层面的推断。 另一方面，当 α = 0.0 \alpha=0.0 时，所有次级研究将获得均等权重；在 5% 的抽样比例下，每个次级研究将分配到 72 项初级研究（34,528 34,528 × \times 0.05 0.05 / 24）。 这将使整体数据集过度偏向小型研究，造成严重失真。 α = 0.5 \alpha=0.5 这一数值是一种折中方案，因为它在跨所有分层的均等分配与按各分层规模进行比例分配之间取得了平衡（Bankier, 1988）。 表 3 列出了次级研究、其完整的初级研究数量以及被抽样的初级研究数量。 实验中使用的完整数据集包含 34,528 行，而 5% 的抽样数据集则包含 1,726 篇论文。 可以注意到，抽样数据整体的 I:E 比例（21:79）与完整数据集（12:88）存在差异。 这是因为较小的次级研究包含更多研究，因此在功率分配抽样法中其比例权重会相应增加。 对于研究问题 4，研究子集进一步缩减至 448 篇论文，因为我们仅选择了那些属于最适合改进标准 ⑤ 的七项次级研究的论文。

paragraphs.en: Next, we describe how we benchmarked the LLMs for each research question. Tested models for each RQ are listed in Table 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们将说明如何针对每个研究问题对大型语言模型进行基准测试。 针对每个研究问题所测试的模型列于表 4 中。

sents.en: Next, we describe how we benchmarked the LLMs for each research question.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们将说明如何针对每个研究问题对大型语言模型进行基准测试。

sents.en: Tested models for each RQ are listed in Table 4 .
sents.zh: 针对每个研究问题所测试的模型列于表 4 中。

paragraphs.en: For screening on the full dataset (RQ1.1), we re-used the screening results of the seven existing LLMs that were gathered in prior work ( Huotala et al., 2025a ) , and benchmarked two new LLMs (see Table 4 ). For RQ1.2, we derived the sampled screening results for the seven existing LLMs and two new LLMs from RQ1.1, but ran the benchmarks for the remaining six new LLMs that were not benchmarked in RQ1.1. For RQ2, all eight new LLMs were benchmarked on the 5% sample. In the case of RQ3.1 and RQ3.2, the same old and new LLMs as for RQ1.1 were used, as RQ3.1 and RQ3.2 are based on the data gathered from RQ1.1. As benchmarking on the full dataset made it possible to derive the results for the sampled data, we decided to also derive the results for the sampled data in RQ3.1 and RQ3.2, respectively. As all new LLMs were benchmarked for RQ2, we decided to also benchmark them on criteria refinement for RQ4. This makes sense, as both RQ2 and RQ4 use the same user prompt and output schema.
paragraphs.zh: 在完整数据集上的筛选（RQ1.1）中，我们重新使用了先前研究（Huotala et al., 2025a）中收集到的七款现有 LLM 的筛选结果，并对两款新的 LLM 进行了基准测试（见表格 4）。 对于 RQ1.2，我们从 RQ1.1 中获取了七款现有 LLM 和两款新 LLM 的抽样筛选结果，但对 RQ1.1 中未进行基准测试的其余六款新 LLM 进行了基准测试。 对于 RQ2，所有八款新 LLM 均在 5% 的样本数据集上进行了基准测试。 在 RQ3.1 和 RQ3.2 中，我们使用了与 RQ1.1 相同的旧版和新款 LLM，因为 RQ3.1 和 RQ3.2 基于从 RQ1.1 收集的数据。 由于在完整数据集上进行基准测试使得能够从抽样数据中推导出结果，因此我们决定在 RQ3.1 和 RQ3.2 中也分别推导抽样数据的结果。 由于所有新 LLM 都在 RQ2 中进行了基准测试，因此我们决定也在 RQ4 的准则优化环节对它们进行基准测试。 这是合理的，因为 RQ2 和 RQ4 都使用了相同的用户提示和输出格式。

paragraphs.en: One might wonder why certain LLMs were not tested for certain RQs. After we first had benchmarked two new LLMs, Qwen 3.6 Plus and DeepSeek V4 Pro, for RQ1.1, we decided to not run rest of them (GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GLM 5.1, Kimi K2.6, or Grok 4.20 Beta) on the full dataset, as running these LLMs on the full dataset would have inflated costs significantly, and current LLMs are quite expensive to run ( Felizardo et al., 2025 ) . 10 10 10 Our current cost for this study was $1,100. Had we tested those models with the full SESR-Eval dataset, we estimated a cost of about $6,500. After reviewing prior observations that the performance differences between LLMs are fairly narrow ( Huotala et al., 2025a ) , testing only two of the new LLMs for RQ1.1 was justified. As the sampled data represents 5% of the full dataset with greatly reduced costs, we were able to benchmark all new LLMs for RQ1.2, RQ2, and RQ4.
paragraphs.zh: 人们或许会好奇，为何某些大型语言模型（LLM）未被用于特定研究问题（RQ）的测试。 在首次对两款新的大型语言模型——Qwen 3.6 Plus 和 DeepSeek V4 Pro——进行 RQ1.1 基准测试后，我们决定不再将其余模型（GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.7、Gemini 3.1 Pro、GLM 5.1、Kimi K2.6 或 Grok 4.20 Beta）运行于完整数据集上。这是因为在完整数据集上运行这些模型会显著推高成本，而当前的大型语言模型运行成本本就相当高昂（Felizardo 等，2025）。10 10 10 本研究目前的总成本为 1,100 美元。 如果我们将这些模型全部用于完整的 SESR-Eval 数据集测试，估计成本将约为 6,500 美元。 在回顾了此前关于大型语言模型之间性能差异其实相当有限的观察结果（Huotala 等，2025a）后，我们认定仅对两款新的大型语言模型进行 RQ1.1 测试是合理的。 由于抽样数据占完整数据集的 5%，且成本大幅降低，因此我们能够对所有新的大型语言模型进行 RQ1.2、RQ2 和 RQ4 的基准测试。

paragraphs.en: We used OpenRouter ( Aubakirova et al., 2026 ) to access the LLMs, which provides a unified application programming interface (API) to call the LLMs routed through the service. An additional benefit of using OpenRouter was that it supports Pydantic AI out of the box, which is a model-agnostic Python framework. It provides automatic output validation, error handling, and retry support that makes it possible to call LLMs reliably. Our recent work used OpenRouter and Pydantic AI for paper screening and it worked very well for benchmarking multi-vendor LLMs ( Huotala et al., 2025a ) . The scripts are available in the paper’s research artifact ( Huotala et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 OpenRouter（Aubakirova 等人，2026）访问大型语言模型（LLM），它提供了一个统一的应用编程接口（API），用于调用通过该服务路由的 LLM。 使用 OpenRouter 的另一个好处是，它开箱即用地支持 Pydantic AI，这是一个与具体模型无关的 Python 框架。 它提供了自动输出验证、错误处理和重试支持，从而能够可靠地调用 LLM。 我们最近的研究中使用了 OpenRouter 和 Pydantic AI 进行论文筛选，这种方法在基准测试多供应商 LLM 时效果非常好（Huotala 等人，2025a）。 相关脚本可在该论文的科研成果资料中获取（Huotala 等人，2026b）。

paragraphs.en: For RQ2, the changes made to the user prompt in V2 were tightly coupled with the motivation behind the respective RQ. Removing the overall screening decision field necessitated refining the user prompt, as the screening decision of the LLMs relied on the criterion decisions. Because of this, the instructions given to the LLMs were refined to better guide the LLMs’ interpretation of the criteria. Also for RQ4, the V2 version user prompt was used, because it focused solely on refining inclusion and exclusion criteria; the refinements made for V2 version of user prompt aimed to provide an improved guidance for the LLMs and to reduce the ambiguity of applying criteria ④.
paragraphs.zh: 对于研究问题2（RQ2），V2版本中用户提示所做的修改与各自研究问题的核心动机紧密相关。 移除整体筛选决策字段后，必须对用户提示进行优化，因为大型语言模型（LLM）的筛选决策依赖于各项标准的判断结果。 因此，对大型语言模型（LLM）的指令进行了优化，以更好地引导其对各标准项的解释。 同样对于研究问题4（RQ4），也使用了V2版本的用户提示，因为它仅聚焦于优化纳入与排除标准；V2版本用户提示的改进旨在为大型语言模型（LLM）提供更清晰的指导，并减少应用标准④时的模糊性。

sents.en: For RQ2, the changes made to the user prompt in V2 were tightly coupled with the motivation behind the respective RQ.
sents.zh: 对于研究问题2（RQ2），V2版本中用户提示所做的修改与各自研究问题的核心动机紧密相关。

sents.zh: 移除整体筛选决策字段后，必须对用户提示进行优化，因为大型语言模型（LLM）的筛选决策依赖于各项标准的判断结果。

sents.zh: 因此，对大型语言模型（LLM）的指令进行了优化，以更好地引导其对各标准项的解释。

sents.en: Also for RQ4, the V2 version user prompt was used, because it focused solely on refining inclusion and exclusion criteria; the refinements made for V2 version of user prompt aimed to provide an improved guidance for the LLMs and to reduce the ambiguity of applying criteria ④.
sents.zh: 同样对于研究问题4（RQ4），也使用了V2版本的用户提示，因为它仅聚焦于优化纳入与排除标准；V2版本用户提示的改进旨在为大型语言模型（LLM）提供更清晰的指导，并减少应用标准④时的模糊性。

paragraphs.en: No changes were made for the output schema for RQ1.1, RQ1.2, RQ3.1, or RQ3.2, as the results were directly compared with prior work ( Huotala et al., 2025a ) . On the other hand, significant changes were implemented to the V2 output schema (RQ2 and RQ4).
paragraphs.zh: RQ1.1、RQ1.2、RQ3.1 或 RQ3.2 的输出模式未作任何更改，因为结果与先前的研究（Huotala et al., 2025a）进行了直接比较。 另一方面，V2 输出模式（RQ2 和 RQ4）则实施了重大更改。

sents.en: No changes were made for the output schema for RQ1.1, RQ1.2, RQ3.1, or RQ3.2, as the results were directly compared with prior work ( Huotala et al., 2025a ) .
sents.zh: RQ1.1、RQ1.2、RQ3.1 或 RQ3.2 的输出模式未作任何更改，因为结果与先前的研究（Huotala et al., 2025a）进行了直接比较。

sents.en: On the other hand, significant changes were implemented to the V2 output schema (RQ2 and RQ4).
sents.zh: 另一方面，V2 输出模式（RQ2 和 RQ4）则实施了重大更改。

paragraphs.en: First, the overall decision field was removed from the output schema, as the overall decision was computed from the inclusion and exclusion criterion decisions, making the overall decision field redundant.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，整体决策字段已从输出模式中被移除，因为整体决策是根据纳入和排除标准决策计算得出的，这使得整体决策字段变得多余。

paragraphs.en: Second, we added extra validation for the criterion name format as an attempt to improve reliability of the structured responses. The increased number of LLMs tested increases the likelihood of LLMs hallucinating the output, and letting the Pydantic AI library apply stricter output validations is an attempt to mitigate this.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，我们为标准名称格式增加了额外的验证，试图提高结构化响应的可靠性。 测试的 LLM 数量增加，使得 LLM 产生幻觉输出的可能性也随之上升；让 Pydantic AI 库应用更严格的输出验证，正是为了缓解这一问题。

sents.en: Second, we added extra validation for the criterion name format as an attempt to improve reliability of the structured responses.
sents.zh: 其次，我们为标准名称格式增加了额外的验证，试图提高结构化响应的可靠性。

sents.en: The increased number of LLMs tested increases the likelihood of LLMs hallucinating the output, and letting the Pydantic AI library apply stricter output validations is an attempt to mitigate this.
sents.zh: 测试的 LLM 数量增加，使得 LLM 产生幻觉输出的可能性也随之上升；让 Pydantic AI 库应用更严格的输出验证，正是为了缓解这一问题。

paragraphs.en: Third, the Python classes for Criterion and Decision were split for inclusion and exclusion criteria, as we wanted to make sure that the LLMs rigorously understand the difference between inclusion and exclusion criterion evaluations. Lastly, we clarified how the binary and probabilistic decisions are related to each other, e.g. the probabilistic decision means the probability of an inclusion criteria being met, and for exclusion criteria, this means the probability of the exclusion criterion being met. This was to mitigate a potential misunderstanding of the LLMs where the LLM could misunderstand the probability of exclusion as "how certain the LLM is about its answer". If the LLM output JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) that did not meet the output schema, Pydantic AI automatically retried the request and instructed the LLM to correct the mistake.
paragraphs.zh: 第三，我们将 Criterion 和 Decision 的 Python 类拆分为纳入标准和排除标准，因为我们希望确保大型语言模型能够严格理解纳入标准和排除标准评估之间的区别。 最后，我们阐明了二元决策和概率性决策之间的关系，例如，概率性决策意味着满足某项纳入标准的概率，而对于排除标准而言，则意味着满足该排除标准的概率。 这样做是为了缓解大型语言模型可能存在的误解，即它可能会将排除标准的概率误解为“大型语言模型对其答案的确定程度”。 如果大型语言模型输出的 JavaScript 对象表示法（JSON）不符合输出模式，Pydantic AI 会自动重试请求，并指示大型语言模型纠正错误。

sents.en: Third, the Python classes for Criterion and Decision were split for inclusion and exclusion criteria, as we wanted to make sure that the LLMs rigorously understand the difference between inclusion and exclusion criterion evaluations.
sents.zh: 第三，我们将 Criterion 和 Decision 的 Python 类拆分为纳入标准和排除标准，因为我们希望确保大型语言模型能够严格理解纳入标准和排除标准评估之间的区别。

sents.en: Lastly, we clarified how the binary and probabilistic decisions are related to each other, e.g. the probabilistic decision means the probability of an inclusion criteria being met, and for exclusion criteria, this means the probability of the exclusion criterion being met.
sents.zh: 最后，我们阐明了二元决策和概率性决策之间的关系，例如，概率性决策意味着满足某项纳入标准的概率，而对于排除标准而言，则意味着满足该排除标准的概率。

sents.en: This was to mitigate a potential misunderstanding of the LLMs where the LLM could misunderstand the probability of exclusion as "how certain the LLM is about its answer".
sents.zh: 这样做是为了缓解大型语言模型可能存在的误解，即它可能会将排除标准的概率误解为“大型语言模型对其答案的确定程度”。

sents.en: If the LLM output JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) that did not meet the output schema, Pydantic AI automatically retried the request and instructed the LLM to correct the mistake.
sents.zh: 如果大型语言模型输出的 JavaScript 对象表示法（JSON）不符合输出模式，Pydantic AI 会自动重试请求，并指示大型语言模型纠正错误。

paragraphs.en: To study the agreement between LLMs in overall decision RQ3.1 and criteria RQ3.2, we first retrieved the raw responses of the LLMs originally collected for RQ1.1. These raw responses contained the original screening responses, which we parsed as objects. From the objects, we retrieved the binary_decision field, which indicates the LLMs overall screening decision. For studying the agreement across the inclusion and exclusion criteria in RQ3.2, we extracted the results corresponding to the inclusion and/or exclusion criteria, that were also found from the raw responses originally collected for RQ1.1.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究 LLM 在总体决策（RQ3.1）和标准（RQ3.2）之间的一致性，我们首先检索了最初为 RQ1.1 收集的 LLM 原始响应。 这些原始响应包含了最初的筛选结果，我们将它们解析为对象。 从这些对象中，我们提取了 binary_decision 字段，该字段表示 LLM 的总体筛选决策。 为了研究 RQ3.2 中纳入和排除标准之间的一致性，我们提取了与纳入和/或排除标准相对应的结果，这些结果同样来自最初为 RQ1.1 收集的原始响应。

paragraphs.en: Our motivation behind modifying criteria in RQ4 was that improving poorly formatted, unclear, or ambiguous criteria may decrease the likelihood of an incorrect overall or criterion screening decision. As this part was somewhat experimental and as modifying criteria takes a lot of time, we focused on the secondary studies that LLMs had challenges making the correct decision for includes and excludes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 RQ4 中修改标准背后的动机是：改进格式不佳、不清晰或模棱两可的标准，可能会降低做出错误整体或标准筛选决策的可能性。 由于这一部分带有一定的实验性质，而且修改标准需要大量时间，因此我们重点关注了 LLM 在判断“包含”和“排除”时难以做出正确决策的次要研究。

paragraphs.en: We began by analyzing the criterion-level agreements from Online resource 3 ( Huotala et al., 2026b ) and looking at Table 8 to see, which secondary studies had most disagreement ⑤. We then selected seven secondary studies from Table 8 ( Rodríguez-Pérez et al., 2021 ; Bjarnason et al., 2023 ; Zhang and Li, 2020 ; Tebes et al., 2020 ; Alonso et al., 2023 ; Lenarduzzi et al., 2021 ; Deckers and Lago, 2022 ) . For this experiment, we selected all new LLMs from Table 4 ⑤, as we wanted to make the results fully comparable with RQ2.

paragraphs.en: The criteria modification process ⑥ was performed by the third author. The second author verified the third author’s criteria modification suggestions. After the criteria modification process was finished, we then re-benchmarked the primary studies using eight LLMs (GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GLM 5.1, Kimi K2.6, Grok 4.20 Beta, Qwen 3.6 Plus, and DeepSeek V4 Pro) on the 5% sampled data, filtered to the selected seven secondary studies (N=448), using the V2 user prompt and output schema. For RQ4, we computed accuracy, precision, recall, F1, MCC, Gwet’s First-order Agreement Coefficient (Gwet’s AC1), and lost evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 标准修改过程⑥由第三位作者执行。 第二位作者验证了第三位作者提出的标准修改建议。 标准修改过程结束后，我们使用八种大型语言模型（GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.7、Gemini 3.1 Pro、GLM 5.1、Kimi K2.6、Grok 4.20 Beta、Qwen 3.6 Plus 和 DeepSeek V4 Pro），在筛选出的七项次级研究（N=448）的 5% 抽样数据上，结合 V2 用户提示词和输出模式，对原始研究进行了重新基准测试。 针对研究问题 4，我们计算了准确率、精确率、召回率、F1 分数、MCC、Gwet 一阶一致性系数（Gwet’s AC1）以及证据丢失情况。

paragraphs.en: Abbreviations and acronyms were expanded, as acronyms can be misleading, e.g. if the LLM fails to understand the context of the abbreviation or acronym. For instance, continuous integration (CI) and confidence interval (CI) have matching acronyms, but mean totally different things. This might lead the LLM to misclassify a paper that mentions continuous integration in the abstract, but the LLM interprets the acronym as confidence interval.
paragraphs.zh: 缩写和首字母缩略词均被展开，因为首字母缩略词可能会产生误导，例如当大语言模型无法理解该缩写或首字母缩略词的背景时。 例如，“持续集成”（CI）和“置信区间”（CI）的首字母缩略词相同，但含义却截然不同。 这可能导致大语言模型错误地将一篇在摘要中提及“持续集成”的论文归类为涉及“置信区间”的论文。

sents.zh: 缩写和首字母缩略词均被展开，因为首字母缩略词可能会产生误导，例如当大语言模型无法理解该缩写或首字母缩略词的背景时。

sents.en: For instance, continuous integration (CI) and confidence interval (CI) have matching acronyms, but mean totally different things.
sents.zh: 例如，“持续集成”（CI）和“置信区间”（CI）的首字母缩略词相同，但含义却截然不同。

sents.en: This might lead the LLM to misclassify a paper that mentions continuous integration in the abstract, but the LLM interprets the acronym as confidence interval.
sents.zh: 这可能导致大语言模型错误地将一篇在摘要中提及“持续集成”的论文归类为涉及“置信区间”的论文。

paragraphs.en: Long criteria that contain multiple different rules were split into separate, simpler rules so each can be evaluated clearly and independently by the LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 包含多个不同规则的长标准被拆分为独立、更简单的规则，以便大型语言模型能够清晰且独立地评估每一条规则。

paragraphs.en: If the LLM cannot determine a criterion’s outcome by the paper’s title/abstract, it can lead to false negatives or false positives. Paper abstracts rarely contain information regarding e.g. publication year or venue.
paragraphs.zh: 如果大型语言模型无法通过论文标题或摘要确定某个标准的结果，就可能导致假阴性或假阳性。 论文摘要很少包含诸如发表年份或发表渠道等信息。

sents.en: If the LLM cannot determine a criterion’s outcome by the paper’s title/abstract, it can lead to false negatives or false positives.
sents.zh: 如果大型语言模型无法通过论文标题或摘要确定某个标准的结果，就可能导致假阴性或假阳性。

sents.en: Paper abstracts rarely contain information regarding e.g. publication year or venue.

paragraphs.en: We converted negations to affirmative form, so they describe the desired criteria directly. Affirmative rules are easier to interpret and we have witnessed LLMs tripping over negation, especially when present in exclusion rules ( Mäntylä et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将否定形式转换为肯定形式，这样它们就能直接描述所需的标准。 肯定规则更容易理解，而且我们已经观察到大型语言模型在处理否定时会出现问题，尤其是在排除规则中（Mäntylä 等，2026）。

sents.zh: 我们将否定形式转换为肯定形式，这样它们就能直接描述所需的标准。

paragraphs.en: We kept the criteria as close as possible to their original wording to preserve the intent of the underlying SR. The rewording was limited to changes needed for consistency, clarity, and LLM interpretability, as larger changes to the criterion could alter the meaning of it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们尽可能保留标准原文的措辞，以维持其底层 SR 的原始意图。 改写仅限于为保持一致性、清晰性和 LLM 可解释性而必需的调整，因为对标准进行较大改动可能会改变其含义。

paragraphs.en: Next, we describe each statistical method we used and motivate their use. For all the metrics (excluding regression model), we used the confusion matrices as a single source of truth, and include them in our research artifact ( Huotala et al., 2026b ) as recommended by Madeyski et al. (2026) . True positives (TP) indicate correctly included studies, while true negatives (TN) indicate correctly excluded studies. On the contrary, false negatives (FN) are studies incorrectly excluded and false positives (FP) are studies incorrectly included.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们将描述所使用的每种统计方法，并说明采用这些方法的原因。 对于所有指标（回归模型除外），我们以混淆矩阵作为唯一的真实依据，并按照 Madeyski 等人（2026）的建议，将其纳入我们的研究成果（Huotala 等人，2026b）。 真阳性（TP）表示被正确纳入的研究，而真阴性（TN）表示被正确排除的研究。 相反，假阴性（FN）是被错误排除的研究，而假阳性（FP）则是被错误纳入的研究。

paragraphs.en: In our experiments we reported accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 scores to make the screening results comparable with prior work, and the corresponding metrics are industry-standard metrics for reporting empirical software engineering research. Accuracy was used to measure the general correctness of the LLMs, and precision and recall were used to measure the LLM’s correctness in correctly included studies, while F1 presents precision and recall as a harmonic mean ( Manning et al., 2008 ) .
